binary_build: Built by the full test run at the merge commit; four unrelated failures were reproduced on clean upstream. No production changes since that build.
fixture: Synthetic 32x24 RGB8 canvas; Red/Green strokes; partial selection; Green targeted with RGB visible; inside drag +3,+2; Warp; hide target; separate five-arrow nudge, geometry undo and commit cases
nudge_clock_note: The offscreen driver advances a synthetic frame clock between control calls. A configured 10-second pause keeps the five calls in one nudge group; default pause timing is covered by the upstream nudge regressions.
observations: Only Green moves in affine, Warp and arrow-nudge previews/commit; Red remains fixed. The outline follows the transform. Hiding Green preserves Warp controls and geometry. One Undo returns the configured five-nudge group to its original (16, 12) pivot without editing document pixels.
